operation.summary: Monitor resources (A0189): Bridgit's own footprint over time, never other apps or content: CPU, memory, network, disk, storage, context switches (the wakeup proxy), with battery and thermal state as device context. Off by default; switch it and choose the interval (1s, 10s, 1m default, 1h) with the settings device.resource_monitor and device.resource_monitor_interval (POST /v1/settings, or POST /v1/owner/configuration/settings with the owner.configuration grant)

query.name: view
query.description: summary (default: status, current hour, today), samples (raw samples), hourly or daily (summaries per period and build)

query.name: since
query.description: Only entries at or after this time: ISO 8601 (2026-11-09T10:00:00Z) or epoch milliseconds

operation.returns: enabled, running, since, stopped_at, interval, interval_s, intervals, default_interval (1m), level (current hour: ok|elevated|high), latest (newest sample), scope (bridgit_only), platform, bridgit_name, build {version, version_code, commit}, current_hour, today (summaries), thresholds {metric: {elevated, high}}, retention {samples, hours, days, samples_kept}, measures (what each number is; Android gives apps no per-app energy or wakeup count), view, and samples[] | hours[] | days[]. A sample: at, interval_s, build, version_code, cpu_percent (of one core), cpu_device_percent, rss_mb, peak_rss_mb, java_heap_mb, native_heap_mb, threads, network_bytes {rx, tx}, disk_bytes {read, write}, context_switches, storage_mb, battery {percent, charging, temperature_c}, thermal, monitor_cost_ms. A summary: period, start, end, build, version_code, samples, covered_s, cpu_percent {avg, peak}, rss_mb {avg, peak}, peak_rss_mb, network_bytes, network_mb_per_hour, disk_bytes, disk_write_mb_per_hour, context_switches, context_switches_per_s, storage_mb, battery_percent {first, last}, thermal_worst, monitor_cost_ms, level, over [{metric, value, level}]. Unavailable numbers are null
